quarterly_data.signal: Cadence's contracted but unsatisfied performance obligations of $8.1 billion as of June 30, 2026 included $0.9 billion of non-cancelable customer commitments where product selection and quantities are to be determined by customers later. Excluding those commitments, Cadence expected to recognize 58% as revenue over the next 12 months and 40% over the next 13 to 36 months.
